tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Saltmere Hospitality** runs 45 hotels under three brands, including a dozen franchised properties operated by independent partners.

**Current Environment:**
- Microsoft Entra tenant: saltmerehotels.com, hybrid identities synced from on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS)
- Storage account **stsaltmeredocs** (StorageV2, West Europe) holds scanned booking documents in Blob Storage
- Storage account **stsaltmerefiles** hosts Azure file shares used by front-desk staff at every hotel
- Franchise partners receive time-limited access to specific blob containers to upload and download settlement documents

**Business Requirements:**
- Partner access must be revocable per partner, immediately, when a franchise agreement ends
- Front-desk staff must access file shares with their existing corporate identities
- Booking document scans must also exist in a second region for compliance

tabs.title: Storage Environment
tabs.content:
**Partner Document Exchange (stsaltmeredocs):**
- Each franchise partner gets a shared access signature (SAS) URL for its own container
- Account keys must not be regenerated when a single partner is off-boarded, because other partners and internal systems would be disrupted

**Staff File Shares (stsaltmerefiles):**
- SMB file shares mounted on hotel front-desk workstations that are joined to the on-premises AD DS domain
- The storage account has been configured for identity-based authentication
- Access must be governed both at the share level and by NTFS-style permissions on folders

**Compliance Replication:**
- Scanned booking documents in `stsaltmeredocs` (West Europe) must be copied asynchronously to storage account **stsaltmereuk** in UK South
- The compliance team asked what must be configured on the two accounts before a replication policy can be created
